market.worldSizeUSD_B_range: Global needle roller bearings market: $5.27B (2025) to $6.81B by 2029 (6.6%/yr) per one estimate, vs. $8.636B (2025), 4.84%/yr (2026-2035) per another — vendor estimates disagree by ~60% on base size. India needle roller bearing market: $428M (2024), roughly flat YoY (described as having contracted modestly).
exportGeographies: not itemized — SNL Bearings states it exports to 'many countries across the globe' without specifics
market.domesticSlice: Asia-Pacific holds ~45% of global share. NRB Bearings Ltd (India, listed, founded 1965) holds ~70% of India's organized needle roller bearing market as first mover, and owns 73.45% of SNL Bearings.

structureFacts: IATF 16949:2016 is the baseline quality certification required to supply automotive OEMs

EV transition is a structural risk/opportunity: needle roller bearings are heavily used in ICE transmissions; industry commentary suggests a pivot toward EV transmission/chassis applications to offset ICE-bearing demand decline
Aerospace & defence diversification is a broader industry trend among Indian auto-component/bearing makers (NRB, Sansera, Craftsman all cited pivoting this direction)

adoptionStructure.note: OEM approved-vendor status (multi-year qualification cycles), IATF 16949 compliance, price competitiveness vs. imports, just-in-time delivery reliability, and increasingly EV-program-specific bearing designs drive purchasing.

peers.name: NRB Bearings Ltd
peers.note: ~70% share of India's organized needle roller bearing market; parent/promoter of SNL Bearings (73.45% ownership); reported an '18% revenue jump' with an aerospace pivot in recent commentary

peers.name: Schaeffler India, Timken India, SKF India, NSK, NBC Bearings
peers.note: named competitors; Schaeffler India trades at ~61x PE, Timken India ~50.8x PE vs. NRB/SNL at lower multiples, implying market views them as more auto-cyclical/lower-growth

drivers: OEM approved-vendor status via multi-year qualification
customerValue.strongestPredictor: OEM approved-vendor status combined with JIT delivery reliability
